description: CLK0 (6m, the wanted signal is the fundamental) with the Si5351 screened and a screened pad at the output, 30 cm of cable and the BNC attenuator marked 10 dB; NO filter

chain.name: screened pad on the CLK0 output
chain.notes: fully screened pad, nominal 8 dB; measured 8.7 dB at 50 MHz (8.5 to 9.5 dB over 20 to 180 MHz) on 2026-11-03 as the drop against the same cable and attenuator without it

chain.name: 30 cm cable
chain.notes: pad to the attenuator; the same cable as in the pad measurements; type not recorded; its loss is included in the measured pad figure

chain.name: attenuator
chain.notes: in front of the analyser; marked 10 dB, about 27 dB at VHF (flat 20-180 MHz, measured earlier); not re-measured at 50 MHz in this chain

notes: New topology (2026-11-03): screened board, screened pad at the output, no filter. Run at 2 and 4 mA only because 6 and 8 mA would put the analyser input above the -25 dBm limit with this much pad; this is a different parameter set from the filtered runs, so the Compare view will flag it. pad_db is 35.7 dB.
